eyebrow.zh: 一行接入 · 协议无感 · 开源

headline.zh:
把国产大模型接进任意编码 agent
工具调用不再静默错配
headline.en:
Wire a Chinese frontier model into any coding agent
Tool calls stop breaking in silence

sub.zh: 一层薄协议适配：你现有的 agent 代码路径一行不改，错位的工具调用自动归位。
sub.en: A thin protocol shim: your existing agent code path stays untouched while misaligned tool calls fall into place.

body.zh: 换后端模型后，工具调用的参数形状对不上，agent 三帧之后才崩。一层适配把它归位成标准形状，调用直接成功。
body.en: Swap the backend model and the tool-call argument shape stops matching — the agent crashes three frames later. The shim normalizes it to the standard shape so the call just works.

body.zh: 一行 wrap 你现有的客户端，工具循环、参数解析、调度逻辑全部保持原样——它根本不知道后端换了模型。
body.en: Wrap your existing client in one line; the tool loop, argument parsing, and dispatch all stay exactly as they were — it never learns the backend model changed.

body.zh: 开启流式时，增量分片被原样归一后交给 agent，工具参数由 agent 自己拼装——和标准流式协议一模一样。
body.en: With streaming on, incremental fragments are normalized and handed to the agent, which assembles the arguments itself — exactly like the standard streaming protocol.

body.zh: 遇到没覆盖的工具调用形状，抛一个有名字的显式错误，而不是返回半成品让 agent 在几帧之后才崩——和今天的静默错配正好相反。
body.en: On a tool-call shape it doesn't cover, it raises a named, explicit error instead of returning a half-parsed payload that breaks the agent later — the opposite of today's silent mis-parsing.

headline.zh: 一行接入，工具循环跑通
headline.en: One line in, the tool loop runs clean

sub.zh: 开源 Apache 2.0，pip 即装，国产模型适配先行。
sub.en: Open source under Apache 2.0, pip-installable, Chinese-model adapters first.
